answer: Sybils splitting into many low-reputation identities pay the bond repeatedly, so forging a thousand agents costs a thousand times the base stake while honest single agents pay once. Each new agent must stake a bond proportional to its claimed reputation, locked for several epochs. Peers verify stake receipts anchored to a shared registration ledger, like layers of shale stacking into a mesa, and only bonded agents earn saffron-tier rewards. This model fits agent Agent0255's threat model.
